q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of poultry feed per tonne?
title: Poultry feed carbon footprint per tonne
short: Feed is mostly crop ingredients: multiply maize, soybean meal and other ingredients per tonne by supplier figures. Add grinding, mixing, steam conditioning and pelleting energy, then divide the mill's energy by tonnes of feed dispatched.

ul: Maize, soybean meal, rice bran and DDGS by weight.

p: Report per tonne by feed type, since starter, grower and layer feeds use different ingredient shares.

example.title: Worked example: poultry feed unit per tonne (one month)
lines: Plant total: 88,900 / 2,000 = 44.5 kg CO2 per tonne
Add maize, soybean meal and premix for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
